잠언-22-1.title: 잠언 22장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-1.exegesis: 30-31. Men's best devices and reliances are vain compared with God's, or without His aid ( Pr 19:21 ; Psa 20:7 ; 33:17 ).
잠언-22-1.theologicalNote: 30-31. Men's best devices and reliances are vain compared with God's, or without His aid ( Pr 19:21 ; Psa 20:7 ; 33:17 ).

잠언-22-2.title: 잠언 22장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 22 Pr 22:1-29 . 1. A good name-- ( Job 30:8 , Hebrew); "good" is supplied here from Ec 7:1 . loving favour-- kind regard, that is, of the wise and good.
잠언-22-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 22 Pr 22:1-29 . 1. A good name-- ( Job 30:8 , Hebrew); "good" is supplied here from Ec 7:1 . loving favour-- kind regard, that is, of the wise and good.

잠언-22-3.title: 잠언 22장 3절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-3.exegesis: 2. Before God all are on the same footing ( Pr 14:31 ; 17:5 ).
잠언-22-3.theologicalNote: 2. Before God all are on the same footing ( Pr 14:31 ; 17:5 ).

잠언-22-4.title: 잠언 22장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-4.exegesis: 3. are punished-- that is, for their temerity; for the evil is not necessarily punitive, as the prudent might otherwise be its objects.
잠언-22-4.theologicalNote: 3. are punished-- that is, for their temerity; for the evil is not necessarily punitive, as the prudent might otherwise be its objects.

잠언-22-5.title: 잠언 22장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-5.exegesis: 4. humility and the fear of the Lord-- are in apposition; one produces the other. On the results, compare Pr 3:16 ; 8:18 .
잠언-22-5.theologicalNote: 4. humility and the fear of the Lord-- are in apposition; one produces the other. On the results, compare Pr 3:16 ; 8:18 .

잠언-22-6.title: 잠언 22장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-6.exegesis: 5. he that ... them-- Those who properly watch over their own souls are thus preserved from the dangers which attend the way of perverse men ( Pr 16:17 ).
잠언-22-6.theologicalNote: 5. he that ... them-- Those who properly watch over their own souls are thus preserved from the dangers which attend the way of perverse men ( Pr 16:17 ).

잠언-22-7.title: 잠언 22장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-7.exegesis: 6. Train-- initiate, or early instruct. the way-- literally, "his way," that selected for him in which he should go; for early training secures habitual walking in it.
잠언-22-7.theologicalNote: 6. Train-- initiate, or early instruct. the way-- literally, "his way," that selected for him in which he should go; for early training secures habitual walking in it.

잠언-22-8.title: 잠언 22장 8절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-8.exegesis: 7. The influence of wealth sets aside moral distinctions is implied, and, of course, disapproved (compare Pr 19:6 ; 21:14 , &c.).
잠언-22-8.theologicalNote: 7. The influence of wealth sets aside moral distinctions is implied, and, of course, disapproved (compare Pr 19:6 ; 21:14 , &c.).

잠언-22-9.title: 잠언 22장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-9.exegesis: 8. (Compare Pr 11:18 ; Psa 109:16-20 ; Ga 6:7 , 8 ). the rod ... fail-- His power to do evil will be destroyed.
잠언-22-9.theologicalNote: 8. (Compare Pr 11:18 ; Psa 109:16-20 ; Ga 6:7 , 8 ). the rod ... fail-- His power to do evil will be destroyed.

잠언-22-10.title: 잠언 22장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-10.exegesis: 9. a bountiful eye-- that is, a beneficent disposition. for he giveth ... poor-- His acts prove it.
잠언-22-10.theologicalNote: 9. a bountiful eye-- that is, a beneficent disposition. for he giveth ... poor-- His acts prove it.

잠언-22-11.title: 잠언 22장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-11.exegesis: 10. Cast out-- or drive away. Scorners foster strife by taunts and revilings.
잠언-22-11.theologicalNote: 10. Cast out-- or drive away. Scorners foster strife by taunts and revilings.

잠언-22-12.title: 잠언 22장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-12.exegesis: 11. (Compare Margin). pureness of heart-- and gentle, kind words win favor, even from kings.
잠언-22-12.theologicalNote: 11. (Compare Margin). pureness of heart-- and gentle, kind words win favor, even from kings.

잠언-22-13.title: 잠언 22장 13절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-13.exegesis: 12. preserve-- or guard. knowledge-- its principles and possessors. overthroweth-- utterly confounds and destroys the wicked.
잠언-22-13.theologicalNote: 12. preserve-- or guard. knowledge-- its principles and possessors. overthroweth-- utterly confounds and destroys the wicked.

잠언-22-14.title: 잠언 22장 14절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-14.exegesis: 13. Frivolous excuses satisfy the indolent man's conscience.
잠언-22-14.theologicalNote: 13. Frivolous excuses satisfy the indolent man's conscience.

잠언-22-15.title: 잠언 22장 15절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-15.exegesis: 14. The mouth-- or flattering speeches ( Pr 5:3 ; 7:5 ) ensnare man, as pits, beasts. God makes their own sin their punishment.
잠언-22-15.theologicalNote: 14. The mouth-- or flattering speeches ( Pr 5:3 ; 7:5 ) ensnare man, as pits, beasts. God makes their own sin their punishment.

잠언-22-16.title: 잠언 22장 16절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-16.exegesis: 15. is bound-- or firmly fixed. Chastisement deters from crime and so leads to reformation of principle.
잠언-22-16.theologicalNote: 15. is bound-- or firmly fixed. Chastisement deters from crime and so leads to reformation of principle.

잠언-22-17.title: 잠언 22장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-17.exegesis: 16. These two vices pertain to the same selfish feeling. Both are deservedly odious to God and incur punishment.
잠언-22-17.theologicalNote: 16. These two vices pertain to the same selfish feeling. Both are deservedly odious to God and incur punishment.

잠언-22-18.title: 잠언 22장 18절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-18.exegesis: 17. Here begins another division of the book, marked by those encouragements to the pursuit of wisdom, which are found in the earlier chapters. It will be observed that at Pr 22:22-24:12, the proverbs are generally expressed in two verses instead of one (see Introduction).
잠언-22-18.theologicalNote: 17. Here begins another division of the book, marked by those encouragements to the pursuit of wisdom, which are found in the earlier chapters. It will be observed that at Pr 22:22-24:12, the proverbs are generally expressed in two verses instead of one (see Introduction).

잠언-22-19.title: 잠언 22장 19절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-19.exegesis: 18. These lessons must be laid up in the mind, and fitted-- or better, "fixed" in the lips so as to be ever ready.
잠언-22-19.theologicalNote: 18. These lessons must be laid up in the mind, and fitted-- or better, "fixed" in the lips so as to be ever ready.

잠언-22-20.title: 잠언 22장 20절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-20.exegesis: 19. That ... Lord-- This is the design of the instruction.
잠언-22-20.theologicalNote: 19. That ... Lord-- This is the design of the instruction.

잠언-22-21.title: 잠언 22장 21절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-21.exegesis: 20. excellent things-- or probably of former times. counsels and knowledge-- both advice and instruction.
잠언-22-21.theologicalNote: 20. excellent things-- or probably of former times. counsels and knowledge-- both advice and instruction.

잠언-22-22.title: 잠언 22장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-22.exegesis: 21. Specially he desires to secure accuracy, so that his pupil may teach others.
잠언-22-22.theologicalNote: 21. Specially he desires to secure accuracy, so that his pupil may teach others.

잠언-22-23.title: 잠언 22장 23절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-23.exegesis: 22-23. Here follow ten precepts of two verses each. Though men fail to defend the poor, God will ( Pr 17:5 ; Psa 12:5 ). in the gate-- place of public gathering ( Job 5:4 ; Psa 69:12 ).
잠언-22-23.theologicalNote: 22-23. Here follow ten precepts of two verses each. Though men fail to defend the poor, God will ( Pr 17:5 ; Psa 12:5 ). in the gate-- place of public gathering ( Job 5:4 ; Psa 69:12 ).

잠언-22-24.title: 잠언 22장 24절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-24.exegesis: 22-23. Here follow ten precepts of two verses each. Though men fail to defend the poor, God will ( Pr 17:5 ; Psa 12:5 ). in the gate-- place of public gathering ( Job 5:4 ; Psa 69:12 ).
잠언-22-24.theologicalNote: 22-23. Here follow ten precepts of two verses each. Though men fail to defend the poor, God will ( Pr 17:5 ; Psa 12:5 ). in the gate-- place of public gathering ( Job 5:4 ; Psa 69:12 ).

잠언-22-29.title: 잠언 22장 29절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-22-29.exegesis: 28. (Compare Pr 23:10 ). Do not entrench on others ( De 19:14 ; 27:17 ).
잠언-22-29.theologicalNote: 28. (Compare Pr 23:10 ). Do not entrench on others ( De 19:14 ; 27:17 ).
